name: Elemental Healing (Metamagic)
body:
You can use energy from elemental spells to cure good beings, or positive energy to damage evil creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Spell, good alignment, worshiper of a deity granting the Air, Earth, Fire, or Water domain.

Benefits: You can empower an elemental spell (a spell with the acid, cold, electricity, fire, or water descriptor) with healing power, or a healing spell with elemental energy. Both options have the same effect. The selected spell cures good creatures and damages evil creatures for the same amount listed in its description. It has no effect on neutral creatures. The damage inflicted to evil creatures has the same descriptor of the original spell in case of an elemental spell (unless it was modified with Elemental Spell or a similar ability), or a descriptor matching a domain granted by your deity in case of a healing spell; the modified spell gains both the healing descriptor and the appropriate energy descriptor. An elemental healing uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
